_note: Audit checklist templates organized by FSLI / topic, each broken into the five canonical phases. Sample carrier names: Chubb, Progressive, Travelers, MetLife.

templates.name: Loss & LAE Reserves
templates.subtitle: P&C unpaid claims, IBNR, LAE — Schedule P alignment

items.task: Identify lines of business with material reserve exposure (Auto, GL, WC).
Document the appointed actuary and any external reviewer engagement.
Obtain prior-period Statement of Actuarial Opinion and management's reserve range.
Assess inherent risk for long-tail vs short-tail lines.
Identify fraud risk factors in reserve estimation (e.g. earnings smoothing).
Evaluate prior-year reserve development for adverse trend signals.
Walk through case-reserve setting process for largest claims segments.
Test IT general controls over actuarial models and claim systems.
Test management review controls over actuarial central estimate.
Recompute paid loss & ALAE development factors from Schedule P data.
Perform independent IBNR projection using chain-ladder + Bornhuetter-Ferguson.
Test ULAE provisioning (typically a % of paid losses).
Reconcile gross/ceded/net reserves to general ledger and Schedule P.
Compare booked reserve to actuarial central estimate; document margin.
Conclude on reserve adequacy and assess CAM disclosure.
Obtain management representation letter covering reserve estimates.

templates.name: Reinsurance
templates.subtitle: Risk transfer, Schedule F, slow-pay provision, ceded reserves

items.task: Map reinsurance program — quota share, XOL, cat XOL, LPT/ADC.
Identify affiliated vs unaffiliated reinsurer concentrations.
Risk-transfer assessment on retrospective contracts (LPT/ADC).
Evaluate counterparty credit risk and collateralization.
Test contract review controls for new/amended reinsurance.
Test slow-pay monitoring process.
Reconcile ceded premium and recoverables to Schedule F.
Test CECL allowance on reinsurance recoverables (ASC 326-20).
Confirm balances directly with major reinsurers.
Conclude on authorized/unauthorized non-admission impact.
Evaluate CAM disclosure for material reinsurance arrangements.
Inventory investment portfolio by asset class and NAIC designation.
Identify Level 3 / illiquid positions (private placements, CLO equity).
Assess CECL ECL allowance methodology and inputs.
Evaluate impairment / OTTI process for SSAP 43R structured securities.
Test pricing and valuation controls (vendor reconciliation, broker quotes).
Test trade-capture, custody, and reconciliation controls.
Independent price-test sample of bonds + structured securities.
Recompute amortized cost on high-quality bonds.
Test AVR + IMR rollforwards for life insurers.
Conclude on Level 3 valuation, including sensitivities.
Assess disclosure of credit-loss allowance and AOCI rollforward.

templates.name: DAC & Long-Duration Contracts (LDTI)
templates.subtitle: Cohort LFPB, constant-level DAC, MRB fair value

items.task: Inventory cohorts by issue year × product × benefit feature.
Document discount-rate (upper-medium-grade A) sourcing.
Identify LTC cohorts at risk of net-premium-ratio cap breach.
Assess MRB fair-value model and hedging program.
Test annual assumption-review process for cohort LFPB.
Test DAC capitalization criteria (incremental + direct + successful).
Recompute net premium ratio for a sample of cohorts.
Test constant-level DAC amortization on inforce denominator.
Independent MRB valuation on a sample of contracts.
Reconcile rollforwards by cohort to general ledger.
Conclude on LFPB cohort-level disclosure adequacy.
Evaluate CAM for LDTI implementation and LTC unlockings.

templates.name: RBC / ORSA
templates.subtitle: Risk-based capital, ORSA report, Group Capital Calculation

items.task: Map RBC charge components: R-0 through R-5 (P&C) or C-0 through C-4 (Life).
Identify permitted / prescribed practices affecting surplus.
Assess concentration risks (asset class, reinsurer, geography).
Evaluate stress scenarios run by management vs ORSA framework.
Test ORSA governance & sign-off controls.
Test RBC factor inputs from Schedule D / P / F feeds.
Recompute aggregate RBC at year-end with covariance adjustment.
Reconcile Schedule SI permitted practices to RBC impact.
Conclude on RBC headroom and action-level proximity.
Document Group Capital Calculation reconciliation.
